manifest_contract.lineage: Every partition must reference existing raw or partition identities; self-reference, unknown parents and cycles are rejected.

registry.transaction_behavior: One short-lived SQLite connection and transaction per public operation. WAL, foreign_keys=ON, synchronous=FULL and a 10 second SQLite busy timeout are retained. No internal retry is promised.
registry.contention_behavior: Concurrent readers are supported. SQLite writer contention is surfaced by SQLite or typed RegistryError; the caller may retry only retryable failures without changing dataset identity.
registry.schema_behavior: Existing version-0 canonical registries are adopted idempotently as schema version 1 after exact table/index validation. Newer schemas are rejected before mutation.

storage.publication: File payload is written to a same-directory temporary file, flushed, fsynced, atomically replaced and followed by directory fsync. Immutable conflicts fail closed.
storage.cleanup: Only aged files matching the LocalStorage atomic temporary naming pattern are automatically removed. Immutable manifests that lack a Registry row are detected and reported, never auto-deleted.
storage.symlink_policy: Storage and Registry paths reject symbolic-link escape or destination substitution.

forbidden_direct_mutations: direct INSERT, UPDATE or DELETE against Registry SQLite tables
direct PRAGMA changes that weaken WAL, foreign keys or synchronous durability
direct manifest, partition or raw-artifact replacement
deleting immutable unregistered manifests without an explicit repair decision
bypassing descriptor or manifest schema validation
disabling checksum, lineage, root-containment or symlink checks
